assessments.reasoning: Event 8b0626a4d84246bd89044b9d833fdafd captured the pinned set_mempolicy.2 project source. Both copyright lines and all four paragraphs of VERBATIM_PROF are visible in its header.

challenge.method: Checked each spelling and year against the copyright lines, separated the subsequent edit log, and read the final two paragraphs to distinguish the variant from the longer professional-care wording.
challenge.results: All four names occur in the copyright lines. The disclaimer ends at “contained herein” and the final paragraph expressly requires acknowledgment of the copyright and authors under its stated condition.

limitations: The finding applies to the header at ae6b221882ce71ba82fcdbe02419a225111502f0. Its dates concern copyright notices. Later relicensing would be a separate historical observation.
